scoringCalibration: Visual realism is scored independently; passing topology, collision and runtime checks cannot compensate for weak face, skin, hair, clothing or deformation quality.
visualFindings: The lower face is visibly narrower and the cheek-to-jaw transition has more depth than v18.
The eyes remain doll-like because the aperture, lids, lacrimal anatomy and surrounding fat pads lack integrated topology.
The mouth remains a layered surface without a true opening or convincing corners.
The skin remains too uniform and plastic under close review.
The groom still reads as sparse straight fibers over an exposed scalp, especially at the part and side/rear boundaries.
blockingFailures: Integrated eyelid and orbital sculpting is required to remove the doll-like stare.
The mouth base needs a true mouth slit, oral cavity and animation-ready corner loops.
Face planes still require high-resolution manual sculpting around the zygomatic, nasolabial, temporal and jaw regions.
The hair needs a continuous hand-shaped scalp foundation, coherent part, layered clump cards and clean ear/nape transitions.
Skin requires region-specific albedo, pore direction, roughness, oiliness, redness and subsurface response.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the two audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
